prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” interior painting company for everyone in St. Louis — the right choice depends on your project size, budget, timeline, and how much prep or repairs are needed. I can help you find the best fit. A quick plan:

1) Quick questions so I can tailor recommendations
- Is this a home or commercial space?
- Approximate size (one room, whole house, sq ft)?
- Any special needs (wall repair, popcorn ceiling removal, wallpaper removal, trim/cabinet painting)?
- Budget and timeline?
- Do you prefer a local independent shop or a national/franchise company?

2) How to identify the best companies (checklist)
- Licensed and insured (general liability + workers’ comp)
- Local references and a portfolio of similar jobs
- Recent online reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi, BBB)
- Written, itemized estimate (labor, paint brand & sheen, surface prep, repairs)
- Clear start/end dates and cleanup policy
- Warranty or guarantee on workmanship and paint
- Who will do the work (owner/operator vs subcontractors)

3) Sources to check right now
- Google Maps and Google Reviews (search “interior painters near me”)
- Yelp
- Angi/HomeAdvisor
- Better Business Bureau (BBB)
- Nextdoor or local Facebook groups for neighborhood referrals

4) Typical pricing (ballpark)
- Single bedroom: roughly $300–$900 (depends on prep and size)
- Whole interior repaint: could range from a few thousand to $10k+ depending on home size and scope
(These are estimates — always get at least 2–3 written quotes.)

5) Suggested interview questions to ask painters
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you provide proof?
- Do you have references from recent similar jobs?
- What prep and repairs are included?
- Which paint brands and finishes do you use?
- How long will the job take? Who will be on site each day?
- Do you provide a written warranty?

If you want, tell me your zip code/neighborhood and a couple of project details and I’ll give a short vetted list of well-reviewed St. Louis interior painters and help you compare quotes.
